To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a scalable method of fabrication and nanostructuring of p-type skutterudite FexCo1xSb3 has been demonstrated, resulting in strongly improved thermoelectric properties compared to conventionally processed counterparts.

we successfully fabricated nanostructured skutterudes by chemical co- precipitation of oxalates followed by thermal treatment, and that the nanostructuring leads to a reduction of thermal conductivity, which is the main reason for the improved performance of the material.

a novel synthesis route for fabrication of Fe substituted CoSb3 skutterudites has been developed, resulting in a nanostructure of the final product with reduced thermal conductivity and improved thermoelectric properties.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a new method for the fabrication of skutterudite nanostructured materials.
the synthesis and characterization of nanoengineered Fe substituted skutterudite compounds, FexCo(1-x)Sb3 (x= 0, 0.1, 0.2 and 0.3) with high thermoelectric performance.
a novel synthesis route to produce nanostructured FexCo1−xSb3.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the novel scalable synthesis route for the preparation of Fe-substituted nanostructured skutteruidites provides material with less impact to the environment compared to the conventional synthesis procedures, while maintaining the high thermoelectric figure of merit.
the synthesis of Fe substituted nanostructured skutterudeite, FexCoxSb3, by the novel synthesis route is feasible.
the novel synthesis route provides a nanostructured skutterudesite with improved TE properties, and is environmentally benign.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a scalable method to synthesize skutterudite nanostructured powders with high purity, which is followed by spark plasma sintering (SP) technique.
we developed a novel scalable synthesis route for the preparation of nanostructured Fe substituted CoSb3 skutterudites in large quantity.

we have demonstrated that nano-engineered Fe substituted skutterudite FexCo1−xSb3 (x = 0.2 and 0.3) with high figure of merit can be synthesized in large quantities by a scalable and environmentally benign method.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we were successful in fabricating nanostructured Fe substituted skutterudite with improved thermoelectric figure of merit.
the nanostructured FexCo1−xSb3 has a high figure of merit of about 0.25, which is enhanced by 50% with respect to the conventional CoSb3, and the synthesis route is scalable.
a novel synthesis route has been developed to fabricate skutterudite thermoelectric materials with nanostructure.
